calls.title: Christine Heller and Ashley Stirrup
calls.summary: The meeting covered the early-stage growth of the marketing team aimed at high-volume B2C and B2B clients, spearheaded by Ashley Stirrup, who is establishing a demand generation function. The team recently expanded its expertise by hiring specialists, emphasizing a hands-on approach to execution. They aim to increase experimentation velocity, as highlighted by a case study with a client conducting 360 experiments in a year. Additionally, Tangents offers broad marketing execution services focused on content amplification and efficiency, utilizing an offshore model for cost reduction. Their subscription-based engagement allows for flexible project work, supported by project management tools like Basecamp. The conversation concluded with an interest in focusing on content repurposing and upcoming podcast projects.
calls.keywords: Demand generation, Content amplification, Creative services, Marketing automation, Podcast repurposing, Subscription pilot
calls.action_items:

calls.title: Christine Heller and Ashley Stirrup
calls.summary: The purpose of the meeting was to clarify missed emails and reschedule follow-up steps to keep the project on track. Manish acknowledged sending materials after the last meeting, which Ashley did not receive, prompting a resend to facilitate team alignment. They agreed to hold a follow-up meeting on the 21st at 2:00 PM BSP time, during which Manish will provide materials in advance for thorough internal review. The subscription model was discussed, starting at $3,500 per month for 100 hours of work, with a three-month pilot phase to assess fit and scope. Ashley committed to circulating the materials for team feedback to secure internal buy-in, while Manish emphasized adaptability to client needs throughout the engagement.
